text: LlmLiteRtCompiledModelExecutorBase creates its internal sampler once, in InitializeSampler on the first SampleLogits (or benchmark InitializeSampler) call, from the sampler parameters of the LlmContext loaded at that moment; InitializeSampler returns early when sampler_ exists, RestoreContext and UpdateRuntimeConfig don't reset sampler_, and no runtime code calls Sampler::UpdateConfig.
